blocks.text: LATEST UPDATE: 3 fires hit Cebu on All Saints’ Day CEBU CITY, Philippines — A second fire has struck Cebu City on All Saints’ Day. The fire, which hit Barangay Mambaling in the city’s south district, was ongoing as of 6:51 p.m. It has been raised to the third alarm, authorities said. It was the second fire reported in the city on the same day. The first struck an area of Barangay Lahug in the city’s north district.
